newsitem.title: USA: Saratoga files for registration of stock.
newsitem.headline: Saratoga files for registration of stock.

text.p: Saratoga Brands Inc said Monday that on Friday it filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a Form 10-SB for registration of the common stock of its Mobile Caterers Inc subsidiary.
Upon effect of a registration statement, Saratoga Brands said it intends to distribute, as a dividend to its common shareholders, 100 percent of the common stock of Mobile Caterers.

The company said it will distribute one share of Mobile Caterers for each five shares of Saratoga Brands common stock and that Saratoga Brands stock is expected to trade with due bill attached until the execution date.
After the distribution, there will be about 2.2 million common shares of Mobile Caterers issued and outstanding, Saratoga Brands said.
